capabilities: Edit CSV files in a spreadsheet-like table
Sort data by clicking column names
Insert new rows and columns and freeze columns
extras: README warns data loss is a real possibility at this stage and advises backing up CSV files; lists per-file header setting persisted in local storage and auto-saving; installation section appears to reference the wrong plugin folder name (ini-obsidian).
problem: Obsidian treats CSV files as opaque attachments with no way to view or edit their contents.
summary: Spreadsheet-style editor that opens CSV files from the vault as tables you can sort, filter, and edit.
